notes: Documented datasets include Hyperliquid and Lighter trades, candles, funding, open interest, liquidations and order books.
These venues complement but do not replace the project's canonical Binance/Pionex research sources.
Long requests require bounded windows and pagination; partial pages must not be treated as complete history.
Coverage, freshness, incident, latency and status tools can qualify whether a requested historical interval is adequately observed.
Future comparisons should preserve quality metadata and pagination completion beside the market values.
Recorded liquidation data may only enter an event-level adapter after side semantics, timestamps, availability and coverage are verified.
Projected forced-liquidation levels are derived estimates and must remain distinct from observed liquidation events.
No 0xArchive data may infer real missingness or cross-venue correction weights from this evaluation.
Funding and market-structure comparisons must retain venue-specific units and timestamps.
Hyperliquid/Lighter context cannot silently replace Binance/Pionex market authority.
The pinned repository contains documentation and connection metadata rather than the hosted server implementation.
Collection, normalization and quality calculations cannot be independently proven from this repository alone.

overall_decision.recommended_next_step: Retain as a provider candidate. Only build a bounded read-only adapter if a concrete Hyperliquid/Lighter historical-validation question requires it, with coverage and pagination receipts mandatory.
